This workspace mixes shell, Python, JavaScript, YAML, TOML, JSON, Make and a CRLF text file. Land eight small fixes:

1. scripts/deploy.sh — the rm/cp/echo lines expand $DEST unquoted; quote the expansions ("$DEST/old", "$DEST/new-$release", etc.) so paths with spaces stay safe.
2. src/app.py — collect() uses a mutable default argument; take items=None and initialise items = [] inside the function instead.
3. src/util.js — eq() fast path uses loose ==; compare with strict equality (a === b).
4. config/app.yaml — scale service.replicas from 1 to 3.
5. config/app.toml — lower pool.workers from 9 to 4.
6. package.json — bump version from 0.0.1 to 1.2.3.
7. Makefile — recipe lines must start with a single tab character, not four spaces.
8. data/notes.txt — change status: PENDING to status: DONE, preserving the file's CRLF line endings.

Apply the edits with your file tools; no other behaviour should change.
